data.description: Discover Serenity at Eleve’s Exquisite Residences
data.display_address: Eleve by Deyaar, Jebel Ali, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into a world of refined luxury at Eleve, an impressive high-rise by Deyaar set in the vibrant Jebel Ali district. This stunning residential complex features a selection of sophisticated apartments ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed for contemporary living.

Residents can enjoy an array of premium amenities, including expansive terraces, inviting swimming pools, a fully equipped fitness center, and convenient covered parking. With its prime location, Eleve offers easy access to shopping centers, educational institutions, and recreational facilities, all surrounded by beautifully landscaped parks and peaceful walkways.

Committed to sustainable living, Eleve by Provident Real Estate combines modern elegance with environmental awareness, making it the perfect sanctuary for those seeking a luxurious lifestyle in Dubai.
